research: research/2026-10-28 (14 Oct data re-scored; new scrape refused, unpaid Apify invoices) + research/2026-10-14 pattern and ideas + research/demand-map.csv

posts.hook: Telefoni që nuk bie nuk është muaj i keq. Është një sistem që mungon.
posts.idea: A quiet phone is not a bad month, it is a missing system: one line that moves the owner from blaming the season to looking at the system
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #7 @hormozi one-line reframe "This is for now, not forever" (3.0x; 14 Oct pick 'one-line reframe', 2.4-4.4x); vault C1 meaning
posts.hypothesis: A one-line reframe of the owner's own words (the phone goes quiet) gets more sends than the W3 C4 quote reel

posts.hook: Pse të zgjodhën klientët e fundit?
posts.idea: Find, this week's one step: ask your last buyers one question (what almost made you choose someone else?) and copy their exact words into your next post and your reply message
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #1 @eri.businesscoach numbered self-check (30.3x) as the device; OS 12 One Step series, Find step
posts.demand_phrase: klientët vijnë nga rekomandimet, jo çdo muaj
posts.hypothesis: A one-step fix with the exact question to ask gets more saves than the W3 scoreboard carousel

posts.hook: Klientët nuk ikin. Thjesht askush nuk i fton të kthehen.
posts.idea: Clients who bought once don't come back because nobody invites them back: the one invite-back message after the work is done, shown as a client list going grey vs one that gets a message
based_on: research/demand-map.csv 'klientët nuk kthehen' (direct) + brain AV-01 fears ('clients don't come back')
posts.hypothesis: Moving the blame from the client to the missing invite gets sends from owners with repeat-purchase businesses

posts.hook: Hap profilin tënd si një i huaj. 5 pyetje.
posts.idea: Open your profile as a stranger: 5 yes/no questions that show whether a buyer has anything to compare except your price
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #1 @eri.businesscoach numbered owner self-check (30.3x); OS 8.1 header test as the content
posts.hypothesis: A self-check the owner can do in a minute gets ANALIZA comments from owners who fail it

posts.idea: Boosting a post vs building the path after the click: the same euro followed side by side; the boost ends at views, the path has a reply, a second message and a booking step
based_on: vault C1 + brain AV-01 tried ('boosting posts')
posts.hypothesis: A side-by-side of one euro moves owners who already boost posts to ask for the analysis

posts.hook: Nëse nesër je i sëmurë, kush u përgjigjet klientëve të tu?
posts.idea: If you are ill tomorrow, who answers your clients? One owner-fear question that shows the business runs on one person's phone
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #3 @eri.businesscoach owner-fear question image (7.8x, most comments of his week)
posts.demand_phrase: mesazhet mbeten pa përgjigje kur jam në punë
posts.hypothesis: An owner-fear question about being the only one on the phone gets more comments per reach than W2-02

posts.hook: E ndërtove vetë. 5 gjëra që s'duhet t'i mbash më vetëm.
posts.idea: You built it yourself: 5 things an owner should stop carrying alone (every client in your head, every unanswered quote, which ad works, suppliers who don't talk, the guilt of a quiet month)
based_on: research/2026-10-14 #1 and #6 @eri.businesscoach owner mindset carousels (30.3x, 3.8x): posts about the owner beat tips (pattern.txt)
posts.demand_phrase: paguaj disa furnitorë dhe asgjë s'lidhet
posts.hypothesis: An owner-identity carousel builds follows from owners who see themselves in it
